question.worked_solution:
Either the positive or negative of the expression inside the absolute value must be equal to the right-hand side of the equation.

So, we set up the two corresponding equations and solve them independently:

- If $|8-2x|=8-2x,$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|8-2x| & =5 \\ 8-2x & =5 \\ -2x & =-3 \\ \frac{-2x}{-2} & =\frac{-3}{-2} \\ x & =\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

- If $|8-2x|=-(8-2x),$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|8-2x| & =5 \\ -(8-2x) & =5 \\ -8+2x & =5 \\ 2x & =13 \\ \frac{2x}{2} & =\frac{13}{2} \\ x & =\frac{13}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $x=\frac{3}{2}$ and $x=\frac{13}{2}.$
